name: featurehub
description: Manage FeatureHub feature flags and config values from Claude Code through the FeatureHub Admin API. Read-only by default; every write needs your approval.

featurehub_url.title: FeatureHub URL
featurehub_url.description: The address you open the FeatureHub console at, e.g. https://featurehub.example.com

admin_token.title: Admin service account token (option 1)
admin_token.description: Token of a personal admin service account. Leave empty to log in with email and password instead.

email.title: FeatureHub email (option 2)
email.description: Your FeatureHub login email, if you don't have a service account token. Does not work with SSO-only logins.

password.title: FeatureHub password (option 2)
password.description: Your FeatureHub password. Stored in the OS keychain.

write_access.title: Write access
write_access.description: off: Claude can only read. ask: Claude can propose changes, and each one needs your approval.
